entries.name: AuthContext
entries.scope: Type-only peer-authentication shape for client call and interceptor signatures; Fetch calls return null.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension exposing transportSecurityType and sslPeerCertificate with a type-only PeerCertificate reference. This does not expose a TLS socket, peer certificate, or certificate verification API.

entries.name: Call
entries.scope: Type-only union of unary, readable, writable, and duplex client call surfaces.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native root union and any generic stream parameters. This is not a constructor or an internal HTTP/2 Call implementation.

entries.name: CallCredentials
entries.scope: Metadata-generator factories, composition, and asynchronous metadata generation with adapter Metadata identity.
entries.signatureNotes: A concrete class with a private constructor replaces the native abstract extensible class. createEmpty, createFromMetadataGenerator, compose, and generateMetadata are supported; isEmpty is an adapter helper. Native _equals and static CallCredentials.createFromGoogleCredential are absent; use credentials.createFromGoogleCredential instead.

entries.name: CallInvocationTransformer
entries.scope: Type-only hook that receives and returns client invocation properties before transport creation.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native one-argument CallProperties<any, any> to CallProperties<any, any> signature. The nested channel and parent types refer to adapter contracts; it does not permit installing a native transport.

entries.name: CallMetadataOptions
entries.scope: Type-only inputs supplied to a credential generator: method_name and service_url.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal interface with two required string fields. service_url identifies the logical service rather than a gateway or token endpoint.

entries.name: CallOptions
entries.scope: Type-only per-call deadline, host, credentials, parent propagation, and client interceptor options.
entries.signatureNotes: The native options are retained except parent becomes ParentCall or null instead of a union of native server call types. host cannot redirect a call to another authority; unknown keys and invalid propagation flag values are rejected at runtime.

entries.name: CallProperties
entries.scope: Type-only invocation-transformer record for arguments, metadata, call, channel, method definition, options, and callback.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves required and optional native record members. channel is the adapter Channel rather than the native structural Channel interface, and callOptions uses the structural ParentCall contract.

entries.name: CancelRequester
entries.scope: Type-only client interceptor cancellation continuation.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal callback shape (next: () => void) => void. A blocked interceptor continuation does not suspend the adapter's outer deadline or cancellation lifetime.

entries.name: Channel
entries.scope: Logical target, routing, credentials, active call lifetime, and close management; no persistent connection management.
entries.signatureNotes: Constructor options become optional. getConnectivityState accepts an optional boolean and returns only IDLE or SHUTDOWN; watchConnectivityState reports UNIMPLEMENTED. getChannelzRef returns an unregistered sentinel, and createCall(): never replaces native five-argument call creation and throws WGA_METHOD_CONTEXT_REQUIRED. createCallForMethod, createCallLifetime, getReadQueueLimit, and activeCallCount are adapter bridges, not native channel contracts.

entries.name: ChannelCredentials
entries.scope: Fetch HTTPS credentials, explicitly permitted credential-free localhost tests, and call-credential composition.
entries.signatureNotes: A concrete private-constructor class replaces the native abstract class. createSsl keeps its positional arguments but types verifyOptions as unknown and rejects every non-null certificate or verification argument with WGA_UNSUPPORTED_TLS. createFromSecureContext, _equals, and _createSecureConnector are absent; _getCallCredentials is adapter-specific. Preconfigured Fetcher bindings supply mTLS outside this API.

entries.name: ChannelInterface
entries.scope: Type-only reference to this adapter's Channel; it is not a runtime root export.
entries.signatureNotes: Unlike the native structural Channel interface, this aliases a concrete class with private members and adapter lifetime methods. Arbitrary native or structural channel implementations are not assignable overrides; createCall has the adapter's no-argument never signature.

entries.name: ChannelOptions
entries.scope: Type-only options accepted by adapter channel validation, with runtime rejection of unsupported keys and values.
entries.signatureNotes: The native option inventory is intentionally narrowed. The unknown-valued index signature is not permission to use arbitrary options. Retries and channelz accept only 0; reconnect backoff accepts only the inert 1000 default; flow-control-window 262144 and local-subchannel-pool 1 are exact inert SDK hints. Message limits, compression, user agent, and matching-authority options follow adapter policy.

entries.name: Client
entries.scope: Vendored callback and stream client surface over Fetch: unary/server streaming, plus opt-in gateway client/bidi streaming.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains constructor and unary/client-stream four overloads and server/bidi two overloads with Buffer codecs, optional metadata/options, and typed call surfaces. Channel and credential types are adapter-owned. waitForReady always fails asynchronously; getPeer is logical and getAuthContext is null. Request streaming defaults to asynchronous UNIMPLEMENTED; duplicate unary responses are bounded with status 12 rather than native deadline behavior.

entries.name: ClientDuplexStream
entries.scope: Type-only Writable/Readable intersection returned by bidi client methods.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains native request and response generic parameters, codecs, and call event/cancellation members. Actual upload requires experimentalRequestStreaming in grpc-web mode; otherwise the returned surface terminates asynchronously with UNIMPLEMENTED.

entries.name: ClientMethodDefinition
entries.scope: Type-only client method path, stream-kind flags, request serializer, response deserializer, and optional original name.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal interface. Codecs retain Buffer and the two generic parameters; declaring stream flags does not enable an unsupported transport mode.

entries.name: ClientOptions
entries.scope: Type-only channel configuration, client interceptors, invocation transformer, and explicit channel override hooks.
entries.signatureNotes: The native option intersection is retained with adapter ChannelOptions and nominal adapter Channel in channelOverride and channelFactoryOverride. Runtime brand checks reject foreign channels; an override is not a way to inject native HTTP/2.

entries.name: ClientReadableStream
entries.scope: Type-only object-mode response stream with deserialize, cancel, getPeer, metadata/status events, and typed reads.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native generic intersection with ObjectReadable. Adapter runtime additionally connects destroy and early async-iterator return to cancellation; no raw socket or peer certificate is exposed.

entries.name: ClientUnaryCall
entries.scope: Type-only unary result handle with cancellation, logical peer, authentication context, and metadata/status events.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native SurfaceCall alias including its optional intercepting call member. No ClientUnaryCall constructor is exported; values are produced by Client methods and report a null Fetch authentication context.

entries.name: ClientWritableStream
entries.scope: Type-only object-mode upload stream with serializer and client call event/cancellation members.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native generic intersection with ObjectWritable. Upload requires experimentalRequestStreaming in grpc-web mode; the default surface instead reports asynchronous UNIMPLEMENTED before authentication or Fetch.

entries.name: CloseRequester
entries.scope: Type-only client interceptor half-close continuation.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal (next: () => void) => void shape. Runtime half-close waits for earlier transformed messages and forwards at most once.

entries.name: ConnectionInjector
entries.scope: Native server connection injection is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native type passes Duplex connections into Server and drains injected connections. The Fetch server entry accepts Request objects and has no socket-injection substitute.

entries.name: Deadline
entries.scope: Type-only absolute deadline accepted by calls, readiness signatures, and health waiters.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native Date or number union. Deadlines govern the complete adapter call lifetime, including interceptor and admission waits; this alias does not create a timer by itself.

entries.name: FullRequester
entries.scope: Type-only complete client requester with start, sendMessage, halfClose, and cancel callbacks.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal interface. All four fields are required here; use Requester for the Partial form returned by RequesterBuilder.

entries.name: FullResponder
entries.scope: Native complete server response interceptor type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native start/sendMetadata/sendMessage/sendStatus continuation interface requires native server intercepting calls. Fetch server handler return values use the separate /server types.

entries.name: FullServerListener
entries.scope: Native complete server event interceptor type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native metadata/message/half-close/cancel listener members are not a client Listener alias. Fetch request AsyncIterables do not implement this interface.

entries.name: GoogleCredential
entries.scope: Type-only modern Google authentication source accepted by credentials.createFromGoogleCredential.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension accepts synchronous or Promise Headers or records whose values are string, string array, or undefined. This is broader than native OAuth2Client's modern Promise-of-string-record arm; it does not implement ADC or token acquisition.

entries.name: GrpcObject
entries.scope: Type-only namespace tree produced by loadPackageDefinition.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native recursive string index over namespaces, ServiceClientConstructor, and ProtobufTypeDefinition. Constructed clients use adapter credentials and channels.

entries.name: HealthCallOptions
entries.scope: Type-only adapter health-call options adding optional Metadata and AbortSignal to CallOptions.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension; native grpc-js has no equivalent root export. Signals cancel the application-level health RPC, not a native connection readiness probe.

entries.name: HealthCheckResponse
entries.scope: Type-only decoded grpc.health.v1 response used by HealthClient.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension with status: number so unknown future enum values survive decoding. Only the known SERVING number is interpreted as serving.

entries.name: HealthClient
entries.scope: Application-level grpc.health.v1 Check, raw Watch, and managed monitor through an existing adapter Client.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension: constructor(Client), check returning Promise<HealthCheckResponse>, watch returning ClientReadableStream, and monitor returning HealthWatch. It reuses routing and credentials; it does not implement native channel health-check or readiness behavior.

entries.name: HealthServingStatus
entries.scope: Application-health numeric enum UNKNOWN, SERVING, NOT_SERVING, and SERVICE_UNKNOWN.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension with values 0, 1, 2, and 3 from grpc.health.v1. This enum is separate from connectivityState and makes no transport availability claim.

entries.name: HealthWaitOptions
entries.scope: Type-only deadline and optional AbortSignal for a managed health wait.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension requiring an absolute Deadline. A successful wait means an observed SERVING health response, not native channel connectivity.

entries.name: HealthWatch
entries.scope: Managed application-health Watch reconnects, state snapshots, bounded waiters, and explicit close.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension: constructor(HealthClient, service?, options?), getState, waitForServing, and close. Closing cancels the monitor without closing its wrapped Client; the caller owns its Worker lifetime.

entries.name: HealthWatchOptions
entries.scope: Type-only reconnect and attempt-timeout settings for a managed health monitor.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension omits overall deadline and signal from HealthCallOptions and adds bounded backoff controls and optional attemptTimeoutMs. These are not native reconnect or service-config retry settings.

entries.name: HealthWatchState
entries.scope: Type-only immutable snapshot of managed health phase, status, attempt number, and last error code.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension defines connecting/serving/not-serving/reconnecting/disabled/closed phases. servingStatus and lastErrorCode may be null; this is not native connectivity state.

entries.name: InterceptingCall
entries.scope: Client request/response interception with asynchronous continuations, transformed-message ordering, and terminal cleanup.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains constructor and public native call operations; adds disposePending(): void for bounded local cleanup. Pending state machinery is patched to avoid lost transformations and duplicate half-close. Fetch getAuthContext returns null and getPeer is logical, not a socket address.

entries.name: InterceptingCallInterface
entries.scope: Type-only low-level client interceptor forwarding operations.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves native operation signatures and adds optional disposePending(): void. The optional cleanup hook lets the outer call release owned pending work even if a cancellation interceptor never forwards.

entries.name: InterceptingListener
entries.scope: Type-only terminal listener receiving metadata, messages, and status without next callbacks.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the three native required methods and argument types; message remains any. This is the downstream listener shape, not the continuation-based Listener shape.

entries.name: Interceptor
entries.scope: Type-only client interceptor factory taking InterceptorOptions and NextCall.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native InterceptingCall return type. Implementations participate in adapter-managed lifetime and cannot extend a completed RPC by withholding next.

entries.name: InterceptorConfigurationError
entries.scope: Explicit configuration error for mixing interceptor arrays and interceptor providers.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native Error subclass constructor(message: string). It is separate from WorkersGrpcConfigurationError and does not carry a WGA code contract.

entries.name: InterceptorOptions
entries.scope: Type-only per-call options plus a required client method definition for interceptors.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains native extension shape with method_definition: ClientMethodDefinition<any, any>. Inherited parent and credentials use adapter declarations and restrictions.

entries.name: InterceptorProvider
entries.scope: Type-only method-specific client interceptor provider.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native ClientMethodDefinition<any, any> to Interceptor signature. The method definition is client-side and does not install a server interceptor.

entries.name: KeyCertPair
entries.scope: Native server key/certificate tuple type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native private_key/cert_chain Buffer pair configures native ServerCredentials. Fetch server TLS is owned by its deployment, and client binding mTLS does not consume this root type.

entries.name: LegacyGoogleCredential
entries.scope: Type-only legacy callback authentication source accepted by credentials.createFromGoogleCredential.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension preserves getRequestMetadata(url, callback) with Error-or-null and optional string-valued header record. The provider must call back; returning a value or fulfilled Promise does not supply credentials.

entries.name: Listener
entries.scope: Type-only partial client response interceptor hooks.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native Partial<FullListener> shape for metadata, message, and status callbacks that receive next continuations. No runtime Listener constructor is exported.

entries.name: ListenerBuilder
entries.scope: Fluent construction of partial client response interceptor listeners.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains withOnReceiveMetadata, withOnReceiveMessage, and withOnReceiveStatus returning this, plus build(): Listener. The built object uses continuation callbacks and the adapter's terminal lifetime rules.

entries.name: LoadBalancingConfig
entries.scope: Native load-balancing service configuration type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native policy-name-to-object map is not accepted as a Fetch channel option. Gateway selection is explicit transport routing, not a native load-balancing policy implementation.

entries.name: MessageListener
entries.scope: Type-only client response message transformation continuation.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal (message: any, next: (message: any) => void) => void shape. It does not promise memory accounting for arbitrary deserialized JavaScript objects.

entries.name: MessageRequester
entries.scope: Type-only client request message transformation continuation.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal (message: any, next: (message: any) => void) => void shape. Runtime queues retain transformed messages through asynchronous startup.

entries.name: Metadata
entries.scope: Vendored metadata mutation, repeated entries, cloning, merging, opaque values, and header conversion helpers.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves native public methods and Buffer/string value types; adds entries() for repeated-value transport iteration. HTTP/2 helper types are erased imports, not HTTP/2 runtime support. waitForReady/corked true are rejected when sending; transport additionally enforces final budgets and reserved-header rules.

entries.name: MetadataGenerator
entries.scope: Type-only callback metadata factory accepted by CallCredentials.createFromMetadataGenerator.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension equivalent to the native internal CallMetadataGenerator callback shape. It returns void; the runtime contains accidental rejected Promises but requires a callback-produced adapter Metadata value.

entries.name: MetadataListener
entries.scope: Type-only client response metadata transformation continuation.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal (metadata, next) callback with adapter Metadata in both positions. Completion and metadata lifetime still belong to the client call.

entries.name: MetadataOptions
entries.scope: Type-only idempotentRequest, waitForReady, cacheableRequest, and corked booleans stored on Metadata.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves the native option names and optionality. Storage is not support for every behavior: true waitForReady/corked fail on send; idempotency/cacheability hints do not enable native retries or caching.

entries.name: MetadataRequester
entries.scope: Type-only client startup interceptor receiving metadata, listener, and a forwarding callback.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal signature; next accepts Metadata and either InterceptingListener or Listener. Outer deadlines and cancellation remain active while this continuation is withheld.

entries.name: MetadataValue
entries.scope: Type-only metadata entry value.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native string or Buffer union. The runtime requires Buffers for -bin keys and printable ASCII strings for other values, with additional transport-owned header restrictions.

entries.name: MethodConfig
entries.scope: Native per-method service configuration type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Native waitForReady, timeout, message-size, retryPolicy, and hedgingPolicy service-config records are not interpreted. Adapter /config settings and call options have separately documented shapes.

entries.name: MethodDefinition
entries.scope: Type-only combined client/server codec and streaming-kind method definition.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native interface extending ClientMethodDefinition and ServerMethodDefinition with two generic parameters. Its server codecs describe wire conversion and do not provide a native Server implementation.

entries.name: NextCall
entries.scope: Type-only continuation used to create the next client interceptor call.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains native (options: InterceptorOptions) => InterceptingCallInterface. The resulting call remains subject to the adapter's terminal cleanup and transport restrictions.

entries.name: OAuth2Client
entries.scope: The native root Google authentication union alias is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Use GoogleCredential or LegacyGoogleCredential with credentials.createFromGoogleCredential. Those adapter types explicitly describe modern Headers support and the required legacy callback instead of claiming the pinned native alias is present.

entries.name: PackageDefinition
entries.scope: Type-only map accepted by loadPackageDefinition.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal string-indexed union of ServiceDefinition and ProtobufTypeDefinition. It does not read .proto files or load arbitrary filesystem modules.

entries.name: ParentCall
entries.scope: Type-only structural source of inherited deadline and cancellation for a child client call.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension requiring cancelled, getDeadline, on('cancelled'), and removeListener('cancelled'). It deliberately replaces the native server-call union and also accepts the Fetch server context without importing native server types.

entries.name: ProtobufTypeDefinition
entries.scope: Type-only protobuf message/enum descriptor record retained in package-definition trees.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves required format: string, type: object, and fileDescriptorProtos: Buffer[]. Descriptor preservation is not dynamic proto-file loading or native server support.

entries.name: Requester
entries.scope: Type-only partial set of client start, message, half-close, and cancellation hooks.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains native Partial<FullRequester> and continuation signatures. Absent callbacks pass through; asynchronous callbacks are ordered by the adapter's patched interceptor implementation.

entries.name: RequesterBuilder
entries.scope: Fluent construction of partial client request interceptors.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains withStart, withSendMessage, withHalfClose, withCancel, and build(): Requester. The declared callback shapes are unchanged; the downstream implementation enforces transformed-message and half-close ordering.

entries.name: Responder
entries.scope: Native partial server response interceptor type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native Partial<FullResponder> callbacks have server-specific metadata/message/status semantics. Requester is a client interceptor type and is not a replacement.

entries.name: ResponderBuilder
entries.scope: Native fluent server response interceptor builder is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native withStart/withSendMetadata/withSendMessage/withSendStatus/build runtime API requires the unsupported server interceptor chain. Use /server Fetch handlers for server work.

entries.name: RetryPolicy
entries.scope: Native service-config RetryPolicy type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native duration strings and retryable status-name union are not the adapter policy shape. Opt-in exact-method unary replay is configured through WorkersGrpcRetryPolicy on /config, with distinct commitment and throttling semantics.

entries.name: Server
entries.scope: Importable native-server placeholder that rejects construction synchronously.
entries.signatureNotes: constructor(...unknown[]) replaces the native optional ServerOptions constructor and throws WGA_SERVER_UNSUPPORTED. No addService, bindAsync, start, shutdown, or other native server methods are provided. The separate /server Fetch handler is not this class.

entries.name: ServerCredentials
entries.scope: Importable placeholder whose createInsecure and createSsl factories explicitly reject native server use.
entries.signatureNotes: createInsecure(): never and createSsl(...unknown[]): never throw WGA_SERVER_UNSUPPORTED instead of returning native credentials. Unlike the native abstract class, the empty placeholder has an implicit zero-argument constructor that creates an inert object. Native constructor arguments, context/watch/equality methods, and TLS functionality are absent.

entries.name: ServerDuplexStream
entries.scope: Native server bidirectional Node-stream call type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native type combines request reads, response writes, server metadata, and trailer-aware end. Fetch bidi handlers instead receive AsyncIterable requests and return responses under /server types.

entries.name: ServerErrorResponse
entries.scope: Native server Error plus partial-status type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native ServerStatusResponse intersection is separate from client ServiceError. Fetch handlers report errors through GrpcWebServerError on /server.

entries.name: ServerInterceptingCall
entries.scope: Native server intercepting-call runtime class is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Its responder/listener chain, connection details, server metadata, and metric recorder are unavailable through Fetch client transport. InterceptingCall is client-side only.

entries.name: ServerInterceptingCallInterface
entries.scope: Native server interceptor forwarding interface is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Native sendMetadata/sendMessage/sendStatus, getHost, getConnectionInfo, and getMetricsRecorder do not describe the Fetch handler context. No structural compatibility is claimed.

entries.name: ServerInterceptor
entries.scope: Native server interceptor function type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native method-definition and ServerInterceptingCallInterface factory belongs to native ServerOptions. Client Interceptor and /server handlers use different contracts.

entries.name: ServerListener
entries.scope: Native partial server request interceptor listener type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Its metadata/message/half-close/cancel continuation hooks require a native server call. The client Listener cannot substitute for it.

entries.name: ServerListenerBuilder
entries.scope: Native fluent server request interceptor builder is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native receive-metadata/message/half-close/cancel builder methods and ServerListener return type are absent. ListenerBuilder remains client-only.

entries.name: ServerMethodDefinition
entries.scope: Type-only server-side codec half of the shared MethodDefinition format.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves native path, stream booleans, responseSerialize, requestDeserialize, and optional originalName. It is usable by /server Fetch handlers but does not implement native Server calls or handler types.

entries.name: ServerMetricRecorder
entries.scope: Native ORCA server metric recorder is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Native load-reporting and backend metric recording are outside the Fetch adapter. The observer API reports client call/attempt measurements and is not a ServerMetricRecorder substitute.

entries.name: ServerOptions
entries.scope: Native Server constructor options type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Native HTTP/2/channel/server-interceptor options are not accepted by the root Server stub. Configure /server Fetch handler options separately.

entries.name: ServerReadableStream
entries.scope: Native server request-streaming Node Readable call type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native server surface and ObjectReadable intersection are replaced, for Fetch handlers, by lazy AsyncIterable requests plus a separate context; no source-level alias is supplied.

entries.name: ServerUnaryCall
entries.scope: Native unary server call type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native request field, metadata, peer, and server event surface is not the Fetch handler signature. Parent propagation only uses the separately exported structural ParentCall subset.

entries.name: ServerWritableStream
entries.scope: Native server response-streaming Node Writable call type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Native request-bearing calls with sendMetadata and trailer-aware end are not created. /server handlers return AsyncIterable responses instead.

entries.name: ServiceClient
entries.scope: Type-only generated client instance with dynamically named service methods.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal Client subtype and string index returning Function. Service-specific generated declarations are still required for strongly typed individual RPC methods.

entries.name: ServiceClientConstructor
entries.scope: Type-only constructor returned by service factories, with static service and serviceName members.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains native new(address, credentials, options?: Partial<ChannelOptions>) and ServiceClient return shape, using adapter ChannelCredentials and restricted ChannelOptions rather than native channel implementations.

entries.name: ServiceConfig
entries.scope: Native DNS/service-config object type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The adapter does not interpret native loadBalancingConfig, methodConfig, retryThrottling, or DNS TXT selection. Its explicit transport configuration is exposed on /config and /adapter.

entries.name: ServiceDefinition
entries.scope: Type-only readonly method-definition map parameterized by implementation keys.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native mapped-type shape; its default uses a local untyped string-key map rather than exporting native UntypedServiceImplementation. Method codecs do not imply a native server runtime.

entries.name: ServiceError
entries.scope: Type-only client Error with gRPC status code, details, and Metadata.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains native StatusObject & Error. A callback error and a status event can carry distinct outcomes in unary cardinality cases; the alias does not normalize those events.

entries.name: StatusBuilder
entries.scope: Fluent construction of partial client gRPC status records.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains withCode, withDetails, and withMetadata returning this and build(): Partial<StatusObject>. It does not invent defaults for fields that were never set.

entries.name: StatusListener
entries.scope: Type-only client status transformation continuation.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of the native internal (status: StatusObject, next: (status: StatusObject) => void) => void shape. Outer completion remains bounded even if a response interceptor stalls.

entries.name: StatusObject
entries.scope: Type-only complete client status record.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves required code enum, details string, and Metadata fields. Its status enum values match the pinned native values; optional rich status decoding is a separate /status-details entry.

entries.name: UnaryCallback
entries.scope: Type-only unary response callback exported under an additional adapter root name.
entries.signatureNotes: Same signature as native root requestCallback: (err: ServiceError or null, value?: ResponseType) => void. Optional value and nullable error are preserved; no Promise conversion is introduced.

entries.name: UntypedHandleCall
entries.scope: Native union of server RPC handler function types is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native unary/client-stream/server-stream/bidi callback and Node-stream handlers are unavailable. /server uses its own typed handler union with Fetch context and AsyncIterables.

entries.name: UntypedServiceImplementation
entries.scope: Native untyped server method implementation map is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The local default used internally by ServiceDefinition is only a shape for method keys. It is not a public native server handler-map alias and cannot make root Server usable.

entries.name: VerifyOptions
entries.scope: Native TLS peer-verification options type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: checkServerIdentity and rejectUnauthorized configure sockets that Fetch does not expose. ChannelCredentials.createSsl rejects every non-null verification argument; trusted mTLS Fetcher binding configuration is external.

entries.name: WorkersGrpcConfigurationError
entries.scope: Adapter-specific synchronous configuration error with a stable diagnostic code string.
entries.signatureNotes: Adapter root extension of Error with constructor(code: string, message: string) and readonly code. It is not a gRPC ServiceError and does not use numeric status as its code field.

entries.name: addAdminServicesToServer
entries.scope: Native server administration registration function is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native helper attaches administration services to a native Server. Fetch health helpers and /server handlers do not register channelz or native admin endpoints.

entries.name: closeClient
entries.scope: Close the supplied adapter Client and its logical channel.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the native (client: Client) => void signature. Active adapter calls terminate and close is idempotent; it does not drain or manage native HTTP/2 pools.

entries.name: compressionAlgorithms
entries.scope: Pinned numeric compression identifiers identity=0, deflate=1, gzip=2.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves native enum names, numeric values, and reverse lookup shape. Runtime codec support is bounded per-message Fetch compression, not negotiation on a native HTTP/2 connection.

entries.name: connectivityState
entries.scope: Pinned numeric connectivity constants IDLE through SHUTDOWN.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves all five native enum names, values 0 through 4, and reverse lookup shape. The adapter Channel only reports IDLE or SHUTDOWN; exporting READY does not assert readiness detection.

entries.name: credentials
entries.scope: Channel/call credential factories and composition for Fetch authentication.
entries.signatureNotes: createFromSecureContext is absent. createSsl accepts only null/omitted certificate and verification arguments; combineCallCredentials additionally accepts zero inputs, unlike native's required first argument. createFromGoogleCredential accepts modern Headers/synchronous results and legacy callbacks through adapter types. Foreign credential objects and insecure authenticated channels are rejected.

entries.name: deserialize
entries.scope: Type-only response/request codec from Buffer to a generic message.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains native Deserialize<T>'s single Buffer input and T result. It is a lowercase root type alias, not a runtime deserializer or Uint8Array-only substitute.

entries.name: experimental
entries.scope: Native experimental namespace is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Resolvers, load-balancer registration, subchannels, transports, and other namespace members are outside the adapter root. Adapter experimental request streaming is an explicit /config option and does not expose this native namespace.

entries.name: getChannelzHandlers
entries.scope: Native channelz service handlers are not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: There is no native channel/socket registry to query. Channel.getChannelzRef returns only an unregistered sentinel and cannot be used to construct channelz handlers.

entries.name: getChannelzServiceDefinition
entries.scope: Native channelz service-definition factory is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native generated administration service is outside supported imports. This is independent of ordinary loadPackageDefinition support for user-supplied service definitions.

entries.name: getClientChannel
entries.scope: Return exactly the logical Channel owned by the supplied adapter Client.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves the native one-argument helper but returns the adapter concrete Channel instead of native structural Channel. Repeated calls and Client.getChannel return the same object.

entries.name: handleBidiStreamingCall
entries.scope: Native bidirectional server handler function type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native single ServerDuplexStream argument is not the Fetch /server AsyncIterable-request handler signature. Use the explicit Fetch handler types for bidirectional endpoints.

entries.name: handleClientStreamingCall
entries.scope: Native request-streaming server handler function type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native ServerReadableStream plus sendUnaryData callback pair is absent. Fetch handlers consume AsyncIterable requests and return a unary response directly or asynchronously.

entries.name: handleServerStreamingCall
entries.scope: Native response-streaming server handler function type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native ServerWritableStream callback writes directly to a Node stream. Fetch handlers instead return response AsyncIterables under the /server contract.

entries.name: handleUnaryCall
entries.scope: Native unary server handler function type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native ServerUnaryCall plus sendUnaryData callback pair is absent. Fetch unary handlers receive a decoded request and context and return a response value or Promise.

entries.name: load
entries.scope: Deprecated native root proto-file loading stub is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Pinned grpc-js itself declares this function as returning never. Consumers must supply preloaded PackageDefinition objects or the supported pinned build profile; no filesystem/proto loader is added.

entries.name: loadObject
entries.scope: Deprecated native root object-loading stub is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Pinned grpc-js itself declares (value, options) => never. Use loadPackageDefinition for supported preloaded descriptors rather than relying on this absent compatibility stub.

entries.name: loadPackageDefinition
entries.scope: Build namespace trees, generated clients, and preserved protobuf descriptors from preloaded definitions.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains native PackageDefinition to GrpcObject signature and factory semantics. Generated clients use Fetch contracts, and this function does not load files, resolve arbitrary SDK schemas, or construct a native server.

entries.name: logVerbosity
entries.scope: Native diagnostic logging verbosity enum is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native DEBUG/INFO/ERROR constants configure its logging subsystem, which is not bundled. Adapter observers are explicitly configured callbacks rather than global native logger settings.

entries.name: makeClientConstructor
entries.scope: Create a Client subclass with generated methods, original-name aliases, and service metadata.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains native (methods: ServiceDefinition, serviceName: string, classOptions?: {}) => ServiceClientConstructor. Client-stream and bidi method creation preserves the surface but execution requires explicit gateway request-streaming opt-in.

entries.name: makeGenericClientConstructor
entries.scope: Alias of makeClientConstructor using the same factory identity and contract.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains the pinned native alias and the methods/serviceName/optional-classOptions signature. It is not a second implementation or a separate configuration singleton.

entries.name: propagate
entries.scope: Pinned numeric propagation flags DEADLINE=1, CENSUS_STATS_CONTEXT=2, CENSUS_TRACING_CONTEXT=4, CANCELLATION=8, DEFAULTS=65535.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves native names, values, and reverse lookup shape. Runtime propagation implements only structural parent deadlines and cancellation; the legacy Census bits do not create tracing or statistics context propagation.

entries.name: requestCallback
entries.scope: Type-only native root alias for the unary response callback.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains (err: ServiceError or null, value?: ResponseType) => void and aliases the adapter UnaryCallback interface. The extra UnaryCallback root name refers to the same declaration, not a different callback contract.

entries.name: sendUnaryData
entries.scope: Native unary server completion callback type is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: Its error/status, nullable result, trailing Metadata, and flags parameters belong to native server calls. Fetch handlers return response values and use GrpcWebServerError under /server.

entries.name: serialize
entries.scope: Type-only message codec from a generic request/response to Buffer.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains native Serialize<T>'s T input and Buffer output. It is not a runtime serialization helper; client and server methods receive concrete codecs through method definitions.

entries.name: setLogVerbosity
entries.scope: Native process-wide logging configuration function is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native enum-valued setter has no adapter logging backend to configure. Use /config observer callbacks to receive bounded call/attempt events.

entries.name: setLogger
entries.scope: Native process-wide logger injection function is not exported.
entries.signatureNotes: The native Partial<Console> setter is not emulated. Observer exceptions are isolated by the adapter and observers do not expose native diagnostic log streams.

entries.name: status
entries.scope: Pinned numeric gRPC status constants OK through UNAUTHENTICATED.
entries.signatureNotes: Preserves all 17 native enum names, values 0 through 16, and reverse lookup shape. Equal status numbers do not imply identical transport retry, readiness, or unary-cardinality behavior.

entries.name: waitForClientReady
entries.scope: Importable readiness helper that asynchronously reports UNIMPLEMENTED without network work.
entries.signatureNotes: Retains native (client, deadline: Date or number, callback: (error?: Error) => void) => void. Delegates to Client.waitForReady, which reports WGA_CONNECTIVITY_UNSUPPORTED and never reports native connection readiness or success.

extensions.scope: Global immutable transport configuration, resource limits, observer callbacks, explicit unary retry and retry throttling.
extensions.signatureNotes: configureWorkersGrpc and getWorkersGrpcConfig return adapter snapshots; WorkersGrpcConfigurationError retains root identity. Exported WorkersGrpc types describe these settings, not native ChannelOptions or ServiceConfig. Configuration is locked only after a successful globally configured Channel.

extensions.scope: Per-instance transport factory binding shared resource and retry budgets to generated grpc-js and GAX client options.
extensions.signatureNotes: createWorkersGrpcTransport returns channelCredentials, grpcOptions, gaxOptions, resourceUsage, and retryUsage; gaxOptions retains the caller record while adding this root grpc module and fallback:false. Separate factories keep configuration and budgets independent.

extensions.scope: Fetch Request-to-Response binary gRPC-Web handlers for all four RPC shapes, with lazy AsyncIterable request streams.
extensions.signatureNotes: createGrpcWebHandler infers handler kinds from literal stream flags; GrpcWebServerContext implements structural ParentCall. GrpcWebServerError controls explicit peer-visible status. These runtime and type exports are distinct from the unsupported native root Server APIs.

extensions.scope: Optional bounded google.rpc.Status decoding that preserves the original status or error object.
extensions.signatureNotes: decodeGrpcStatusDetails<T> returns GrpcStatusDetailsResult<T> with the identical original status, optional decoded Any details, and bounded diagnostics. Exact-type-URL decoders are synchronous; their failures do not replace the RPC status.

extensions.scope: Opt-in Node-only SDK build tooling and diagnostics for two exact pinned dependency and schema profiles.
extensions.signatureNotes: createGoogleWorkerBuild requires the installed TypeScript module and returns an esbuild plugin, registry path, and manifest; inspectGoogleWorkerProfile returns structured diagnostics. The literal GoogleWorkerProfile union is intentionally closed. This entry is excluded from Worker runtime imports and native root parity.

extensions.scope: Explicit compatibility deep client entry sharing Client and helper identity with the root module.
extensions.signatureNotes: Exports the client declaration module, including callErrorFromStatus and type-only SurfaceCall in addition to root client names. Client.waitForReady and waitForClientReady retain the root import-only failure contract. This allowlisted path does not expose arbitrary upstream internals.

extensions.scope: Extension-suffixed alias of the same explicit deep client entry for consumers that include .js.
extensions.signatureNotes: Resolves to exactly the same client declarations and CommonJS/ESM implementation as ./build/src/client; constructors and helpers keep root identity. Readiness still fails explicitly, and other build/src deep paths remain unexported.
